description:
Code Name: Silver Rings, a top corporate spy, is given the high-stakes mission of retrieving the password to a vault containing the design for a groundbreaking quantum computer. The only problem? His target, the vault’s owner, has lost his memory in a car accident. Desperate, he infiltrates the man’s home, pretending to be his lover...only to discover that the password is hidden within the body of the target’s brother, Cha Won-Woo! As he searches for clues beneath Won-Woo’s clothes, tension builds, with Won-Woo growing increasingly suspicious. What begins as a cat-and-mouse game of seduction turns into a battle of trust and repressed emotions. In the end, will this intrepid mission end with a kiss...or a bullet?

(Source: Lezhin US)
